correctness.rationale: Every 5-subset of Z_12 has trivial translation stabilizer (gcd(5,12)=1), leaving exactly C(12,5)/12=66 orbit representatives in each index. For each pair, the determinant expanded in Q[z]/(Phi_12), Phi_12=z^4-z^2+1, vanishes iff all four exact integer coefficients vanish. Testing all 5x5, 4x4, 3x3 minors gives full complex rank. Independently recomputed all 4,356 representative ranks from the actual census12.json representative sets using exact integer polynomial reduction, finding zero discrepancies and counts 27 rank3, 757 rank4, 3572 rank5. Orbit size 144 gives 3888,109008,514368; 2 all-full-rank representative row sets give 24 full-spark rows. Finite order-twelve enumeration is an exhaustive proof of this finite claim; mod1009 corroboration is not used as complex-rank certification.
